topics.name: Canonical Structure Projection
topics.purpose: Define deterministic projection of contracts into tree/graph/UML/mindmap representations using only explicit containment, relation, ownership, dependency and topic refs.

semantics.source_rule: Projection reads accepted canonical structure only.
semantics.edge_rule: Every rendered semantic edge corresponds to an explicit typed ref.
semantics.uml_rule: UML/class/relation projections preserve exact identities/types/cardinality where represented.
semantics.mindmap_rule: Topic/navigation mindmap projection does not invent semantic containment.
semantics.roundtrip_rule: Editing a visual projection creates candidate structural changes, not direct semantics.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

references.purpose: Topics support navigational projections without ownership transfer.
